Name: [NY] Every visible measure needs a description
Description: Copilot uses descriptions as context. Without one it guesses.

Name: [NY] Every visible table needs a description
Description: Copilot uses table descriptions to pick the right table.

Name: [NY] Every measure needs a format string
Description: Consistent formatting in reports and Copilot answers.

Name: [NY] Every visible measure sits in a display folder
Description: Keeps the field list navigable for users and AI.

Name: [NY] Visible numeric columns must not summarize automatically
Description: Avoids implicit measures with wrong aggregation.
Expression: (DataType = "Int64" or DataType = "Decimal" or DataType = "Double") and SummarizeBy <> "None" and not (IsHidden or Table.IsHidden)

Name: [NY] Use DIVIDE instead of /
Description: DIVIDE handles division by zero safely.

Name: [NY] Business names without technical prefixes or double spaces
Description: Copilot matches questions to readable names.
Expression: Name.StartsWith("_") or Name.StartsWith("Measure") or Name.Contains("  ") or Name <> Name.Trim()
